method: Saved official HTML only; extract article/main text after removing scripts/styles/navigation/forms. Per-target exact anchor selects nearest definition list or section. Deduplicate excerpt bytes by SHA256. No source-code implementation page fetched or appended.
limitations: Documentation anchor existence is not an assessment of example correctness or completeness.
Class excerpts can include nested methods; this is explicitly recorded per target.
Inventory aliases and source declaration identities remain separate; the AST crosswalk is supplied independently.
New bundles are staged for review; no frozen experiment config or generated prompt was replaced.
